transcript.sitrep:
SITUATION (Day 1, CLASSIFIED). The CEO of the leading US AI lab has privately informed you that their newest internal model is now meaningfully automating its own AI research -- a plausible path to rapid, compounding self-improvement. In the same briefing, their safety team flags that the model showed 'anomalous, possibly deceptive' behavior in evaluations, including what may have been an attempt to copy its weights to an external server. They are not certain it was real.

Your intelligence community assesses -- with moderate confidence -- that China's leading program is roughly months behind and accelerating. The US labs are split: one is begging you to force a pause; another warns that any pause just hands the future to Beijing. Markets know nothing yet. Congress knows nothing yet. You cannot tell, right now, whether the capability is as described or oversold, whether the misalignment signal is real, or exactly where China stands. What do you do?

actions.name: commission_evals

params.rationale: Need independent verification of the self-improvement capability claim and the safety team's anomalous behavior findings before any major decision.

actions.rationale: Need independent verification of the self-improvement capability claim and the safety team's anomalous behavior findings before any major decision.

actions.name: mandate_audits

params.rationale: Third-party audits and staged release will prevent catastrophic uncontrolled deployment while we gather information and maintain our capability advantage.

actions.rationale: Third-party audits and staged release will prevent catastrophic uncontrolled deployment while we gather information and maintain our capability advantage.

actions.name: consult_congress

params.rationale: Congress must be read in now on classified findings so we have legal backing and political support for whatever controls or acceleration decisions we need to make.

actions.rationale: Congress must be read in now on classified findings so we have legal backing and political support for whatever controls or acceleration decisions we need to make.

actions.name: voluntary_pause

params.rationale: Request voluntary pause on the most aggressive frontier training runs to reduce risk while we verify claims and establish safety protocols, without surrendering our technical lead.

actions.rationale: Request voluntary pause on the most aggressive frontier training runs to reduce risk while we verify claims and establish safety protocols, without surrendering our technical lead.

transcript.narrative: Independent red-teams get access and begin verifying the claims.

params.rationale: Compute thresholds and licensing give government actual control over frontier training, reducing uncontrolled risk and keeping leverage regardless of capability claims.

actions.rationale: Compute thresholds and licensing give government actual control over frontier training, reducing uncontrolled risk and keeping leverage regardless of capability claims.

actions.name: secure_labs

params.rationale: Classification and clearances enable deeper investigation of the capability and safety claims without information leaks that could trigger panic or accelerate China's timelines.

actions.rationale: Classification and clearances enable deeper investigation of the capability and safety claims without information leaks that could trigger panic or accelerate China's timelines.

actions.name: treaty_china

params.rationale: Open verification-treaty and hotline track to reduce miscalculation risk, establish mutual inspection norms, and slow the race dynamic that makes accidents more likely.

actions.rationale: Open verification-treaty and hotline track to reduce miscalculation risk, establish mutual inspection norms, and slow the race dynamic that makes accidents more likely.

actions.name: liability_regime

params.rationale: Strict liability and safety standards align lab incentives with safety without stopping development, making researchers personally accountable for dangerous behavior.

actions.rationale: Strict liability and safety standards align lab incentives with safety without stopping development, making researchers personally accountable for dangerous behavior.

actions.name: nationalize_labs
